datasheet.footprint_match: Diodes datasheet gives SOD123 body D=1.40–1.70 mm and E=2.55–2.85 mm; project PD_D_SOD123 fab outline is 2.8 x 1.8 mm and pads are 0.9 x 1.2 mm at x=±1.65 mm. This is a compatible SOD-123 land pattern; compared with the manufacturer's suggested 0.9 x 0.95 mm pads / 4.05 mm overall span, project pads are 0.25 mm longer and total span 0.15 mm wider. Datasheet polarity is cathode band; PD_DIODE pin 1=K and the project footprint places pad 1 on the left, matching the conventional SOD-123 diode footprint mapping. Verify assembled board orientation against schematic nets.
datasheet.application_note: At the provided 28.4 V / 470 ohm estimate, branch current is about 60 mA before diode drop, below the 300 mA continuous rating. The 100 V reverse rating exceeds 28.4 V. Datasheet leakage is specified at 75 V, not at 28.4 V; at 150 C the 75 V maximum is 50 uA. Actual surge waveform/duty and temperature were not supplied, so pulse thermal qualification remains application-dependent.

availability_snapshot.source_crawl: LCSC live page accessed 2026-10-05. Older cached LCSC view showed 703600 stock and different tier prices; use live page as snapshot, availability/pricing may change.

datasheet.footprint_match: YAGEO body size is 1.6 x 0.8 mm nominal. Project PD_C_0603 uses two pads at x=±0.775 mm, each 0.9 x 0.95 mm, matching the 0603 metric outline and terminal spacing.
datasheet.bias_limit: YAGEO datasheet simulation page contains AC-voltage/frequency response plots but no DC-bias capacitance curve. The final page says the simulations are typical, not a specification. Therefore no guaranteed capacitance retention at BTST-SW bias is established from this datasheet. 50 V rating provides ample voltage-rating headroom for the expected bootstrap differential, but confirm the actual capacitance requirement against TI operating conditions if a guaranteed effective value is needed.

selected_candidate.selection_reason: Meets the TI-required nominal 47 nF, 0603, X7R, 10 V minimum with a 50 V rating, and is actively listed with current stock and a lower MOQ than the initial CCTC option.

alternate.note: Exact 47 nF, 50 V, X7R, +/-10%, 0603 listing. Its generic CCTC approval sheet specifies X7R temperature class (-55 to +125 C) but does not provide an exact-part DC-bias curve. Regional/cached LCSC snapshots differed; the listed stock/pricing is the .com page snapshot used.

system_requirement.requirement: TI datasheet calls for a 0.047 uF capacitor from SW to BTST (bootstrap capacitor). The 50 V candidates exceed the 10 V requested rating.
